title: Laughing Our Way to Victory
description: In this lively and uplifting sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner challenges his congregation to break free from the chaos and negativity of the world and cultivate a spirit of joy and laughter in their lives. With infectious enthusiasm and a deep understanding of God's presence, Pastor Chris shows us that even in the midst of destruction and famine, we can laugh and find joy in our Lord. Join us as we discover the power of joy and how it can transform our lives and relationships.
